adaptiveSlotCursor.configScreen.title: %s Settings
adaptiveSlotCursor.configScreen.option.m:
A global toggle for all of the cursors of this mod.

Note: the mod only works if "Allow Cursor Changes" in Minecraft's Mouse Settings is enabled!
adaptiveSlotCursor.configScreen.option.c: The cursor to use when no item is carried and a slot with an item is hovered
The base cursor to use when an item is carried (may be replaced by the settings below)
The cursor to use when an item is carried and it can be placed in the hovered slot
The cursor to use when an item is carried and it cannot be placed in the hovered slot
The cursor to use when an item is carried and it cannot be placed in the hovered slot, but matching items can be picked up from that slot
